lines.en: label christmasfive7:
{i}Back in the golden room, where things were finally beginning to settle down...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}回到黄金厅,这里的一切终于开始平静下来……{/i}

lines.en: scene goldensanta1
: {b}Attention, members of Class 1-A — Secret Santa will begin momentarily. Please retrieve your gifts and prepare to be disappointed if Sensei was assigned to you.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}注意,1-A 班的各位——秘密圣诞老人即将开始。请取回你们的礼物,并且如果抽到 Sensei 的话,请做好失望的准备。{/b}

lines.en: : {b}AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊!{/b}

lines.en: : {b}Sorry, Miku.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}抱歉,Miku。{/b}

lines.en: : Is the megaphone really necessary, Touka?!
lines.zh: : 扩音器真的有必要吗,Touka?!

lines.en: : {b}Unfortunately, yes. My voice is too gentle and proper to penetrate the mass amount of Christmas joy circulating throughout the room.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}很遗憾,有必要。我的声音太温柔、太得体,穿不透这满屋子里流动的圣诞欢乐。{/b}

lines.en: : {b}I’M GONNA PENETRATE YOU IF YOU DON’T TURN THAT DAMN THING OFF!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}你要是不把这该死的东西关掉,我就来穿透你!{/b}

lines.en: : {b}Earbuds are available at the front of the room for anyone sensitive to noise. Thank you.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}对噪音敏感的同学可以在教室前排领取耳塞。谢谢。{/b}

lines.en: scene goldensanta2
: Finished? Can I go back to having ears now?
lines.zh: : 说完了吗?我现在可以把耳朵要回来了吗?

lines.en: : Are you not a musician? I was under the impression you were always exposed to loud noises.
lines.zh: : 你不是音乐家吗?我还以为你们总是暴露在巨大的噪音里。

lines.en: : Just because I’m a musician doesn’t mean I’ve blown my ears out. That’s one of the few stereotypes attributed to us and it’s almost always totally untrue.
lines.zh: : 我是音乐家,不代表我就把耳朵听炸了。那是少数几个套在我们身上的刻板印象之一,而且几乎总是完全不成立的。

lines.en: : Touka, what was that announcement? I couldn’t hear-
lines.zh: : Touka,刚才广播说的是什么?我没听见——

lines.en: scene goldensanta1
: {b}Secret Santa will begin momentarily. Please retrieve your gifts and prepare to be disappointed if Sensei was assigned to you.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}注意,1-A 班的各位——秘密圣诞老人即将开始。请取回你们的礼物,并且如果抽到 Sensei 的话,请做好失望的准备。{/b}

lines.en: : Thank you!
lines.zh: : 谢谢!

lines.en: : You’re not doing our kind any favors, Noriko! Take your bad hearing somewhere else!
lines.zh: : Noriko,你可没给我们这行帮上什么忙!把你那糟糕的听力带到别处去!

lines.en: : What?! Touka, can you hand the megaphone over to Otoha so I can hear what she just said?!
lines.zh: : 什么?!Touka,你能把扩音器递给 Otoha 吗,好让我听见她刚说了什么?!

lines.en: : {b}She said you’re not doing musicians any favors to dismantle the offensive stereotypes that are apparently linked to you. This is news to me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {b}她说你这样可没帮上音乐家的忙,没能打破那些显然贴在你们身上的冒犯性刻板印象。这我倒是头一回听说。{/b}

lines.en: scene black
: {b}THAT’S IT! PREPARE TO GET PENETRATED, HORSE GIRL!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}够了!准备好被穿透吧,马女!{/b}

lines.en: : {b}Security — please restrain this boisterous elf at once before my chastity is lost to another girl. Thank you.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}安保——请立刻制服这个喧闹的小精灵,免得我的贞操又断送在另一个女孩手里。谢谢。{/b}

lines.en: scene goldensanta3
: {b}Somebody gimme a weapon! Ayane! Gun! Now!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}谁来给我件武器!Ayane!枪!马上!{/b}

lines.en: : Hey, you have a weapon. Want to go test out your new crossbow on a few rich dudes?
lines.zh: : 嘿,你不是有武器吗。想不想拿你的新弩去几个有钱人身上试试?

lines.en: : Heck no, I don’t! This thing ain’t fit for firing, Io! It’s gotta be from, like...the 1800’s or something! I’ve never even held a crossbow this old before!
lines.zh: : 我才不要!这玩意儿根本不能发射,Io!它大概得是……1800 年代的东西吧!我连这么老的弩都没摸过!

lines.en: : Okay. I guess Miku will just die then. Oh well. It was nice almost having two friends for a little while.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那看来 Miku 只能死了。算了。有那么一小会儿几乎拥有两个朋友,感觉还不错。

lines.en: : Where the heck did Ayane even get this thing?
lines.zh: : Ayane 到底是从哪儿弄来这东西的?

lines.en: : Probably...the same weapons dealer she gets the rest of her stuff from? Is it really that impressive?
lines.zh: : 大概……就是她买其他那些东西的同一个军火商吧?这有那么值得大惊小怪吗?

lines.en: scene goldensanta4
: Heck if I know! All I’m good for is shooting them. But {i}this{/i} one feels more like a display piece.
lines.zh: : 我他妈哪知道!我唯一擅长的就是开枪。可{i}这{/i}一件感觉更像是个摆设。

lines.en: : Well, where are you going to display it? Because our dorm room is starting to look like my aunt’s garage and I’m pretty sure we don’t have anywhere to put it.
lines.zh: : 那你要摆在哪儿?我们宿舍现在已经快像我姑姑的车库了,而且我很确定我们已经没地方放了。

lines.en: : It’s not {i}that{/i} bad, is it?
lines.zh: : 没{i}那么{/i}糟吧?

lines.en: : You just lost Leonard for like a whole week because he was buried under a pile of clothes.
lines.zh: : 你刚刚才把 Leonard 弄丢了差不多整整一周,就因为他被埋在一堆衣服底下。

lines.en: scene goldensanta5
: Leonard can take care of himself. Plus, he likes the dark. Where’s {i}your{/i} present though, Io?
lines.zh: : Leonard 能照顾好自己。再说,他喜欢黑的地方。不过{i}你的{/i}礼物呢,Io?

lines.en: : I don’t know. Maybe Sensei was supposed to get me something? Or his creepy niece? Or that green-eyed bimbo who’s always trying to be friends with me?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。也许是 Sensei 该送我什么?或者他那个瘆人的侄女?还是那个总想跟我交朋友的绿眼睛蠢妞?

lines.en: : Kirin? You guys would be nice together. Her eyes match your hair.
lines.zh: : Kirin?你们俩会挺合得来的。她的眼睛和你的头发很配。

lines.en: : Wow, you’re totally right. We {i}would{/i} be great friends. I forgot about how important that shared connection is.
lines.zh: : 哇,你说得太对了。我们会成为很好的朋友。我都忘了这种共同点有多重要。

lines.en: scene goldensanta6
: Looks like {i}I’ll{/i} just have to be your present then.
lines.zh: : 看来只好由{i}我{/i}来当你的礼物了。

lines.en: : Can I keep the wrapping paper on?
lines.zh: : 我能不拆包装纸吗?

lines.en: : Sure. I’ll be your doll for the entire year, so you can do whatever you want with me.
lines.zh: : 当然。我会当你一整年的洋娃娃,所以你想对我做什么都行。

lines.en: : I’ve only had one doll in my life and I took its head off like, immediately.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子只拥有过一个洋娃娃,而我几乎是立刻就把它的头给拧下来了。

lines.en: : But surely you wouldn’t do that to {i}me,{/i} right?
lines.zh: : 不过你肯定不会对{i}我{/i}做那种事,对吧?

lines.en: : {i}Riiiiiiight?{/i}
scene goldensanta7
: Right?...
: Do you really think those puppy dog eyes work on me?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得那种小狗眼神对我有用?

lines.en: scene goldensanta8
: Well, you’re right. Because they totally do.
lines.zh: : 嗯,你说对了。因为它们完全有用。

lines.en: scene black
: We’re not playing dress-up or any of that lame stuff, though. We’re learning glassblowing together.
lines.zh: : 不过我们不会玩换装游戏或者那种没劲的东西。我们要一起学吹玻璃。

lines.en: : Yay! Me and Io get to blow something together that doesn’t make her want to puke!
lines.zh: : 好耶!我和 Io 要一起吹点东西了,这次还不会让她想吐!

lines.en: : On second thought, maybe I’ll just go alone.
lines.zh: : 再想想,也许我还是一个人去吧。

lines.en: scene goldensanta9
: Ahh, Christmas — the one day of the year where I can wait for people to give me gifts without being called rude.
lines.zh: : 啊,圣诞节——一年之中唯一一天,我可以等着别人送我礼物,还不会被说没礼貌。

lines.en: : Yeah, it’s lots’a fun when Touka ain’t screaming into a megaphone. Plus, ya got that whole ramen thingy from Sana to spend the next week or two chowin’ down on.
lines.zh: : 是啊,只要 Touka 别对着扩音器尖叫就很有意思。再说了,Sana 送了你那一整套拉面,够你接下来一两周慢慢吃的。

lines.en: : And what an excellent gift it is. It never ceases to amaze me how all of you can so easily figure out what I want most.
lines.zh: : 那是多棒的礼物啊。你们所有人都能这么轻易地猜出我最想要什么,这一点总让我惊叹不已。

lines.en: : Yeah! Same here! I usually don’t realize what I even want ‘til it’s in my hands, though.
lines.zh: : 是啊!我也一样!不过我通常要等东西到手了,才意识到自己想要的是什么。

lines.en: : And...this year...
lines.zh: : 而且……今年……

lines.en: : This year what?
lines.zh: : 今年什么?

lines.en: scene goldensanta10
: Is that...toy...what you wanted the most?...
lines.zh: : 那个……玩具……就是你最想要的?……

lines.en: : You know it! I’ve gotta stretch out my girl parts so that I don’t wind up in the hospital. You’re small. You know how it is.
lines.zh: : 那当然!我得把我的女孩子部件撑开,免得最后进医院。你那么小。你懂的。
: 我懂吗?……

lines.en: : That device is meant to be inserted inside of you?
lines.zh: : 那个器具是要插进你身体里的?

lines.en: scene goldensanta11
: Yup! Just shove it in there every night before bed and you’ll be ready for a real wiener in no time at all! Like that whole thing about apples and doctors. A dildo each day keeps the damage away!
lines.zh: : 对!每天睡前把它塞进去,你很快就能准备好迎接一根真正的香肠了!就像那个苹果和医生的说法。一天一根假鸡巴,损伤远离我!

lines.en: : Fascinating. I had no idea they were so dangerous.
lines.zh: : 真有意思。我不知道它们竟然这么危险。

lines.en: : So is just...is just {i}everyone{/i} open about this stuff all of a sudden?...
lines.zh: : 那……难道突然之间{i}所有人{/i}都对这种事这么开放了吗?……

lines.en: scene goldensanta12
: What better time to start experimentin’ than the springtime of our youth? Especially when it actually {i}is{/i} springtime for once.
lines.zh: : 要开始尝试,还有什么时节比我们青春的春天更好?尤其是这一次{i}真的正好是{/i}春天。

lines.en: : After a recent sexual experience with the ghost of Ami’s mother and watching the Emerald Guardian engage in virtual relations, I too am beginning to think more about such conduct.
lines.zh: : 在最近与 Ami 母亲的幽灵有了一次性经历、又看过翡翠守护者进行虚拟性爱之后,我也开始更多地思考这种行为了。

lines.en: : Can you repeat that first part please?
lines.zh: : 你能把前半句重复一遍吗?

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不能。

lines.en: : You wanna give this baby a ride too, Sana? Feel free. Just make sure to wash it when you’re done.
lines.zh: : Sana,你也想来骑一下这宝贝吗?随便你。用完记得洗干净就行。

lines.en: scene goldensanta13
: What?! No! I have...other methods! And you’re not supposed to share those!
lines.zh: : 什么?!不要!我有……别的方法!而且那种东西是不能共享的!

lines.en: : You’re not?
lines.zh: : 不能吗?

lines.en: : This is news to me as well. But the sheer existence of such devices is news to me, so I am not sure if that says much.
lines.zh: : 这对我来说也是新闻。不过光是这种器具的存在本身就已经是我的新闻了,所以我不确定这能说明什么。

lines.en: : No! It’s unsanitary!
lines.zh: : 不行!那不卫生!

lines.en: : Well, duh. That’s why I told you to wash it.
lines.zh: : 那当然。所以我才叫你洗啊。

lines.en: : It’s unsanitary even {i}if{/i} you wash it, Miku!
lines.zh: : {i}就算{/i}洗了也不卫生,Miku!

lines.en: : Oh.
: Okay. Well, definitely don’t tell Makoto I’ve been usin’ hers then.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那千万别告诉 Makoto 我一直在用她的。

lines.en: scene goldensanta14
: You’ve been what?!
lines.zh: : 你一直什么?!

lines.en: : Nobody told me there were unwritten rules about this stuff, Sana! I’m figurin’ basically everything out myself, okay?!
lines.zh: : Sana,又没人告诉过我这种事还有潜规则!基本上全是我自己摸索出来的,好吗?!

lines.en: : This is a common sense thing! Or...maybe it’s not! I don’t know! Either way, I’ve heard way too much about sex toys today! Just...be okay with having a small vagina! You don’t need to stretch it!
lines.zh: : 这是常识吧!或者……也许不是!我不知道!不管怎样,我今天听的性玩具相关的话已经够多了!就……接受自己有个小阴道吧!你不需要把它撑大!

lines.en: : You’re only sayin’ that cause you ain’t had a wiener in you yet! You don’t get it! I bet yours is even smaller than mine!
lines.zh: : 你这么说只是因为你还没被香肠插过!你不懂!我打赌你的比我的还小!

lines.en: : If only there was some way we could compare!
lines.zh: : 要是有个办法能比一比就好了!

lines.en: scene goldensanta15
: It appears that I will need to fuck both of you for the sake of preserving your friendship.
lines.zh: : 看来为了维护你们之间的友谊,我需要把你们两个都操一遍。

lines.en: : You’d really do that for us?
lines.zh: : 你真的愿意为我们做这种事?

lines.en: : Christmas is all about bringing people together. But I must first acquire the penis.
lines.zh: : 圣诞节的意义就在于把人们聚在一起。不过我得先弄一根阴茎来。

lines.en: : I was...thinking more someone like...you know...a {i}boy.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我想的……更像是……你知道的……一个{i}男孩{/i}。

lines.en: : J-Just for...science, though. I need to...prove Miku wrong.
lines.zh: : 不——不过只是……为了科学。我需要……证明 Miku 是错的。

lines.en: : Yeah. And I’ve gotta show Sana that there ain’t no way in a million hells she’s ready for major dong yet. Maybe like a little one, yeah. {i}Major{/i} dong, though? She’d break in half.
lines.zh: : 对。我还得让 Sana 明白,她一百万年都不可能准备好迎接大鸡巴。也许小一点的还行。可{i}大{/i}鸡巴?她会断成两截的。

lines.en: : Do not fear, my companions. I will ask the Emerald Guardian where I can acquire major dong. She will know. She knows all of the sex things.
lines.zh: : 别怕,我的同伴们。我会去问翡翠守护者哪里能弄到大鸡巴。她会知道的。所有跟性有关的事她都知道。

lines.en: : E...Even if this is true...you won’t really be able to...{i}feel{/i} us...Tsuneyo...
lines.zh: : 即……即便这是真的……你也没法真的……{i}感觉到{/i}我们……Tsuneyo……

lines.en: : Maybe we don’t need Tsuneyo at all if we just get a marker and measure how much we can-
lines.zh: : 也许我们根本不需要 Tsuneyo,只要拿支马克笔量一下我们能——

lines.en: : No, I think we need her. I just...you know...
lines.zh: : 不,我觉得我们需要她。我只是……你知道的……

lines.en: : Second opinions are...important.
lines.zh: : 第二意见……很重要。

lines.en: scene black
: My hunt for major dong begins now.
lines.zh: : 我的大鸡巴狩猎现在开始。

lines.en: : Woo! Friendship!
lines.zh: : 哇哦!友谊!

lines.en: : W...Woooo...
While things were going well in the golden room, there was somewhere else things {i}weren’t{/i} going well.
lines.zh: 黄金厅里一切顺利的同时,还有另一个地方{i}并不{/i}顺利。

lines.en: It was somewhere far more special. With {i}someone{/i} far more special currently inside.
lines.zh: 那是个特别得多的地方。此刻在里面的{i}人{/i},也特别得多。

lines.en: She’d been sitting there for hours, hiding from her peers while gazing up at a tree that made her sick to her stomach for reasons she couldn’t properly describe or understand.
lines.zh: 她在那里坐了好几个小时,躲开同学们,抬头望着一棵树——那棵树让她胃里一阵翻江倒海,而她既说不清也不明白为什么。

lines.en: All the while, she’d been hoping she’d be found by a certain someone. Just like she’d hoped on Halloween before someone she {i}didn’t{/i} want to find her did.
lines.zh: 这段时间里,她一直盼着能被某个人找到。就像万圣节那次一样——只不过那次,来找到她的是个她{i}并不{/i}想见的人。

lines.en: That was merely minutes before her new life was ruined — damaged to the point where, no matter what she did from now on, she would never be fully repaired.
lines.zh: 那是她的新人生被毁掉之前仅仅几分钟的事——损坏到这样的程度:从今往后,无论她做什么,都不可能再被完全修复。

lines.en: Things like this happen to everyone at different stages in life.
lines.zh: 这种事会在人生的不同阶段发生在每个人身上。

lines.en: But things like this {i}don’t{/i} normally happen to everyone at different stages in {i}different{/i} lives.
lines.zh: 但这种事,通常不会在同一个人的{i}不同{/i}人生、不同阶段里反复发生。

lines.en: scene goldensanta16
And {i}that{/i} is what made Maya Makinami special.
lines.zh: 而正是{i}这一点{/i},让 Maya Makinami 变得特别。

lines.en: It was less about “who she is” and more about the opportunities she’s had to change.
lines.zh: 与其说是「她是谁」,不如说是她曾经拥有过的、去改变的机会。

lines.en: Yet, despite those countless opportunities, she’d always walked down the same path. Made the same choices. Followed the same footsteps she’d laid in prior timelines, prior chances.
lines.zh: 然而,尽管有那么多机会,她总是走上同一条路。做出同样的选择。沿着她在先前的时间线、先前的机会里留下的同一个脚印往前走。

lines.en: Yet no one, not even I, knew how many it was. Or where those footsteps led to.
lines.zh: 然而没有人,连我也不知道,那究竟有过多少次。也不知道那些脚印通向哪里。

lines.en: They always cut off before they reached the end of the trail.
lines.zh: 它们总是在抵达小径尽头之前就断了。

lines.en: : This is...for me?
lines.zh: : 这是……给我的?

lines.en: : It’s a...present for the...Secret Santa event...
lines.zh: : 是……秘密圣诞老人活动的……礼物……

lines.en: scene goldensanta17
: Oh...right. I think I was...supposed to buy something for Io.
lines.zh: : 哦……对。我想我……本来该给 Io 买点什么。

lines.en: : I don’t know much about you, so...I hope you don’t mind that I asked the others for help.
lines.zh: : 我不是很了解你,所以……希望你不介意我问了其他人。

lines.en: : That shape...that size...I already know it’s a watermelon. I’m not in the mood to celebrate right now, though.
lines.zh: : 那个形状……那个大小……我已经知道是个西瓜了。不过我现在没心情庆祝。

lines.en: : Either way...thanks, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样……谢了,大概吧。

lines.en: : You’re welcome.
lines.zh: : 不客气。

lines.en: : Is...everything okay?
lines.zh: : 你……还好吗?

lines.en: : No? Yes? Whichever answer prevents you from ranting about how I just need to “find the light.”
lines.zh: : 不好?还是好?哪个答案能让你别开始长篇大论地劝我去「寻找光明」,就选哪个。

lines.en: : Touka says it’s best if I don’t always talk about the things I believe in.
lines.zh: : Touka 说,我最好别老是谈我相信的那些东西。

lines.en: : We can talk about you instead, if you like?
lines.zh: : 如果你愿意,我们可以改聊你?

lines.en: : May I...sit with you?
lines.zh: : 我可以……坐你旁边吗?

lines.en: : Do whatever you want. It’s not like anyone else is coming.
lines.zh: : 随你的便。反正也不会有别的人来。

lines.en: scene goldensanta18
: Is there someone in particular you {i}want{/i} to come?
lines.zh: : 有什么特别的人,是你{i}希望{/i}来的吗?

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : It’s the teacher, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是老师吧?

lines.en: : Oh, okay. So does just {i}everyone{/i} know that about me now or something? Were all those years of doing everything possible to keep it hidden worth absolutely nothing?
lines.zh: : 哦,好啊。所以现在是{i}所有人{/i}都知道这件事了吗?那些年我拼了命想把它藏起来,到头来一文不值?

lines.en: : I think it’s...more the fact that your feelings are so strong they can be seen plainly even {i}without{/i} foresight.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……更多是因为你的感情太强烈了,强烈到即便{i}没有{/i}预知能力也能一眼看穿。

lines.en: : You have faced incredible challenges to preserve yourself, haven’t you?
lines.zh: : 为了保住自己,你面对过难以置信的考验,对吧?

lines.en: : That’s one way to put it, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概可以这么说吧。

lines.en: : Then, we’re the same in that regard.
lines.zh: : 那么,在这一点上我们是一样的。

lines.en: scene goldensanta19
: For a long time, I’ve been unsure of who I am when my most defining traits are stripped away. But things have been rather quiet lately...so I’ve had more time to think about it.
lines.zh: : 很长一段时间里,我一直不确定,当自己最鲜明的特质被剥掉之后,我到底是谁。不过最近一切都相当安静……所以我有了更多时间去想这件事。

lines.en: : I’ve been thinking — maybe I like spring better than the summer? The colors are nicer. The heat doesn’t make my uniform stick to my skin. And everything’s not flooded by the sound of cicadas.
lines.zh: : 我一直在想——也许比起夏天,我更喜欢春天?颜色更好看。炎热不会让制服黏在皮肤上。而且一切也不会被蝉鸣淹没。

lines.en: : I still dream of ropes...and red threads that stretch across the city. But when I open my eyes in the morning, I don’t only see the color white anymore. I see everything.
lines.zh: : 我依然会梦见绳子……还有横贯整座城市的红线。可当我早上睁开眼睛,我看到的不再只有白色了。我看见了一切。

lines.en: : Or...maybe it’s less about “seeing” and more about what I imagine is there, hovering behind me — eternally intangible and unblemished by my perpetual impurity.
lines.zh: : 又或者……与其说是「看见」,不如说是我想象着那里有什么东西,悬浮在我身后——永远触摸不到,也不会被我那永恒的污浊所沾染。

lines.en: : Okay. You’ve lost me.
lines.zh: : 好吧。你把我绕晕了。

lines.en: scene goldensanta20
: If you could fit anything in that box...what would it be?
lines.zh: : 如果你能往那个盒子里装任何东西……你会装什么?

lines.en: : It doesn’t have to be tangible. It doesn’t even have to be {i}real.{/i} It can be anything you want.
lines.zh: : 它不一定要是有形的。甚至不一定要是{i}真的{/i}。它可以是任何你想要的东西。

lines.en: : Is “love” too vague of an answer or can I stuff that in there and call it a day?
lines.zh: : 「爱」这个答案太含糊了吗,还是说我能把它塞进去然后就这么算了?

lines.en: : Love from who? Of what type? There’s no box large enough to hold that word in its entirety.
lines.zh: : 谁的爱?哪一种?没有任何盒子大到能装下这个词的全部。

lines.en: scene goldensanta21
: From who do you think?...What {i}kind{/i} do you think?...
lines.zh: : 你觉得是谁的?……你觉得是哪{i}种{/i}?……

lines.en: : You’ve all got me pegged already, don’t you? You know what I want. And it’s not something that could ever be put into a box.
lines.zh: : 你们早就把我看透了,不是吗?你们知道我想要什么。而那是永远不可能被装进盒子里的东西。

lines.en: : You say that now, but you don’t know what the future holds. And with the way you are now, you don’t know what the past held either.
lines.zh: : 你现在是这么说,可你不知道未来会怎样。而以你现在的状态,你也不知道过去曾有过什么。

lines.en: : Oh, good. Am I gonna find out that {i}you{/i} of all people remember the “old” me too?
lines.zh: : 哦,好极了。莫非连{i}你{/i}也记得「原来的」我?

lines.en: scene goldensanta22
: I’m...sorry for the passive-aggressiveness. I get that you’re...different from everyone else. I didn’t mean to say it like-
lines.zh: : 我……为我这种阴阳怪气道歉。我明白你……和其他人不一样。我不是那个意思——

lines.en: : I think she was afraid of me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她曾经害怕我。

lines.en: scene goldensanta23
: I suppose I don’t blame her. People have always been afraid of me.
lines.zh: : 我想我不怪她。人们一直都害怕我。

lines.en: : You’re afraid of me {i}now{/i} too. I can hear it. Feel it. But what no one ever understands is that {i}I’m{/i} afraid as well.
lines.zh: : 你{i}现在{/i}也害怕我。我能听见。能感觉到。可从没有人明白的是,{i}我{/i}也一样在害怕。

lines.en: : One difference between you and her, though...is that she’d have just walked away if I approached her like this.
lines.zh: : 不过你和她有一点不同……如果我这样靠近她,她早就转身走开了。

lines.en: : Maybe it’s because you haven’t seen me at the height of my clairvoyance yet? You’ve yet to witness my violently passionate thoughts about virgins and masturbation. You haven’t seen me as a {i}worm.{/i}
lines.zh: : 也许是因为你还没见过我预知能力最盛时的样子?你还没目睹过我对处女和自慰那些激烈到病态的念头。你还没见过我作为一条{i}虫{/i}的样子。

lines.en: : But I imagine seeing me as {i}Yasu{/i} looks somewhat similar. Disgusting, but in a palatable manner. One that makes you pity me, not worried.
lines.zh: : 不过我想,看着我以 {i}Yasu{/i} 的样子存在,看起来也差不多。令人作呕,但还算能接受。是那种让你怜悯我、而不是为我担心的方式。

lines.en: : I pitied {i}her,{/i} though.
lines.zh: : 不过,我曾经怜悯过{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: : Not because she believed with her whole heart that she {i}knew{/i} what was happening...but that there was so much pain inside of her that she’d stopped even feeling it.
lines.zh: : 不是因为她全心全意地相信自己{i}知道{/i}正在发生什么……而是因为她身体里积着那么多的痛苦,多到她连痛都感觉不到了。

lines.en: scene goldensanta24
: Right now, what you are experiencing would have been all but unfathomable to her. But long before {i}then,{/i} it would have been commonplace.
lines.zh: : 此时此刻你所经历的,对她来说几乎是无法想象的。但在{i}那{/i}之前很久,那会是家常便饭。

lines.en: : You’ve yet to be anesthetized by time and the actions you take in an effort to combat it. And the invisible blood of every clock in the world has returned to its rightful hands rather than yours.
lines.zh: : 你还没有被时间、以及你为了对抗时间所采取的行动麻醉。而世上所有钟表里那看不见的血,已经回到了它们真正的主人手里,而不是你的。

lines.en: : That’s why they shake so much now. That’s why you’re afraid.
lines.zh: : 所以它们现在抖得这么厉害。所以你在害怕。

lines.en: : You don’t realize where we are.
lines.zh: : 你还没意识到我们在哪里。

lines.en: : And...you do?
lines.zh: : 那……你知道?

lines.en: scene goldensanta25
: Sometimes, I think so.
lines.zh: : 有时候,我觉得我知道。

lines.en: : Others...I think I’m just {i}supposed{/i} to think that.
lines.zh: : 另一些时候……我觉得我只是{i}被安排成{/i}该那么想。

lines.en: : There are details unclear to even me...and they fade as the days go by as the voice that once carried them in has decried my worth and all I am. All I was. All I’ll be.
lines.zh: : 有些细节连我自己都不清楚……而它们随着日子一天天流逝而淡去,因为曾经把它们带进来的那个声音,已经否定了我的价值,否定了我的全部。我现在的全部。我过去的全部。我将来的全部。

lines.en: : But even when these eyes are gouged from their sockets, I’ll be able to see that all of this is temporary...
lines.zh: : 可即便这双眼睛被从眼窝里挖出来,我依然能看见,这一切都是暂时的……

lines.en: : That there’s somewhere else we’ll go when we’re no longer needed here. Somewhere bigger. Somewhere better.
lines.zh: : 当我们在这里不再被需要时,我们会去另一个地方。一个更大的地方。更好的地方。

lines.en: : Somewhere {i}she{/i} wanted to go that you haven’t decided exists yet.
lines.zh: : 一个{i}她{/i}想去、而你还没有决定它是否存在的地方。

lines.en: : This world...
lines.zh: : 这个世界……

lines.en: : There’s something...seriously wrong with it...
lines.zh: : 它……有很严重的问题……

lines.en: : Isn’t there?...
lines.zh: : 不是吗?……

lines.en: scene goldensanta26
: Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : But even Heaven has its problems, Maya. If you believe in a place like that...
lines.zh: : 可就连天堂也有它的问题,Maya。如果你相信有那样一个地方的话……

lines.en: : There’s something wrong with every world.
lines.zh: : 每一个世界都有问题。

lines.en: : But maybe there’s one perfect for {i}you?{/i}
lines.zh: : 但也许有一个世界,是专属于{i}你{/i}的完美?

lines.en: : And maybe we’ll meet again there one day.
lines.zh: : 也许有一天,我们会在那里再次相遇。

lines.en: : Maybe when we do, you won’t be afraid of me anymore.
lines.zh: : 也许到那时,你就不会再害怕我了。

lines.en: : I’m not afraid of you, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 我不怕你,Yasu。

lines.en: : Your heart beats faster when you lie. Does it excite you? Or do you just feel guilty?
lines.zh: : 你说谎的时候心跳会变快。这让你兴奋吗?还是说你只是感到愧疚?

lines.en: : Okay. Maybe I’m a {i}little{/i} afraid of you. But still...I think you can be kind of...sweet too. Apparently.
lines.zh: : 好吧。也许我是{i}有点{/i}怕你。不过话说回来……我觉得你有时候也挺……温柔的。显然。

lines.en: : Hm...no change in pace.
lines.zh: : 嗯……心跳没有变化。

lines.en: : I think you’re sweet too, Maya.
lines.zh: : 我也觉得你很温柔,Maya。

lines.en: scene black
: I can’t wait to see you at your ripest.
lines.zh: : 我等不及想看到你最成熟的那一天。
